summary: Steel Aermotor fire tower on Boone Mountain, Elk County, PA: built 1921, removed 1974 per the FFLOS register. Sources disagree on county; no site description found.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1974, according to the FFLOS register.

events.note: Bare observation point established, per a Department of Forestry report dated December 31, 1917, cited on the Eastern US Lookouts page
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

evidence.supports: steel Aermotor tower built 1921 and removed 1974
evidence.quote: This steel Aermotor tower was built in 1921 and was removed in 1974.

evidence.supports: register places it in Elk County
Eastern page places it in Clearfield County
bare observation point, Department of Forestry report of December 31, 1917
evidence.quote: A bare observation point established. (Report of the Department of Forestry, December 31, 1917)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says Elk County; the Eastern US Lookouts page says Clearfield County. The story reports both and keeps Elk, which the register gives with its coordinates. Not independently confirmed.

notes_for_editor: No staffing, fire, access or visit information was found, so those keys are omitted. The Eastern page coordinates (41.247, -78.64669) sit close to the register's. A gazetteer (mapcarta.com/22708066, not cited) lists a Boone Mountain Fire Tower in Horton Township with no date or condition; that does not show anything stands. The register's separate Boones Mountain Tower Site (US 215) is a different record and was not used. The county conflict is unresolved beyond the register's Elk County.
